C1232.title: SAMR Releases the 2020 Annual Report on Anti-Monopoly Enforcement
C1232.summary: On September 3, 2021, the State Administration for Market Regulation released the Annual Report on China's Anti-Monopoly Enforcement (2020). Its platform-economy section covered unreported concentrations such as Alibaba's acquisition of Intime Retail and the December 2020 investigation into Alibaba's suspected exclusive-dealing conduct.

references.title: SAMR Releases Antitrust Report Including Alibaba Exclusive-Dealing Investigation - 100EC
